claude.sample_unit: English patient education articles (40 with Spanish versions)

links.outcome: Proportion of AI-rewritten patient education materials reaching sixth-grade reading level or below
links.effect: Baseline ≤sixth FKGL was 5.8% English and 10.0% Spanish. After ChatGPT-4.0/Gemini, English 21.4%/60.2%; Spanish 52.5%/77.5% achieved ≤sixth FKGL.
links.quote: 21.4% and 60.2% of ChatGPT-4.0-converted and Google Gemini-converted English PEMs achieved ≤sixth FKGL, respectively.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient materials before and after LLM rewriting to sixth-grade target
links.effect: Baseline ≤sixth FKGL was low for English (5.8%) and Spanish (10.0%); LLM conversion raised this to 21.4-60.2% English and 52.5-77.5% Spanish, with Gemini superior (P<0.05).
links.quote: Baseline readability ≤sixth FKGL was low for English (5.8%) and Spanish (10.0%) articles.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to rewrite existing patient education materials to a lower reading level
Increasing availability of Spanish-language patient education materials

links.effect: Only 5.8% of English and 10.0% of Spanish articles were ≤sixth FKGL.
links.quote: Baseline readability ≤sixth FKGL was low for English (5.8%) and Spanish (10.0%) articles.

links.effect: English PEMs achieved ≤sixth FKGL in 21.4% with ChatGPT-4.0 and 60.2% with Gemini.
links.quote: 21.4% and 60.2% of ChatGPT-4.0-converted and Google Gemini-converted English PEMs achieved ≤sixth FKGL, respectively.

links.effect: Gemini had greater improvements and higher ≤sixth-grade proportions than ChatGPT-4.0; all P < 0.05.
links.quote: Google Gemini had greater absolute improvements in GFI, English FKGL, and Spanish SMOG, and a higher proportion of articles ≤ sixth-grade level (GFI, FKGL, Spanish SMOG) compared with ChatGPT-4.0 (all, P < 0.05).

links.outcome: AI-converted English PEM readability at or below sixth-grade level
links.effect: 21.4% of ChatGPT-4.0-converted and 60.2% of Google Gemini-converted English PEMs achieved <=sixth FKGL.
links.quote: 21.4% and 60.2% of ChatGPT-4.0-converted and Google Gemini-converted English PEMs achieved ≤sixth FKGL, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates using LLMs with specific reading-level prompt constraints to rewrite pediatric patient education materials to a sixth-grade reading level in English and Spanish.
